summary: Iteration 38 — Super Admin People split (Employees vs Clients), Office Admin unified Staff page (profile+login bundled), Staff /my-students with quick-add. Backend pytest: 5/5 PASS. Frontend Playwright: all 3 personas verified end-to-end (SA Employees/Clients render with type-scoped Add buttons; OA shows only nav-office-staff, /employees dispatches to office-staff-page, /staff redirects with 'no access' toast; Staff /my-students renders 3 incentive tiles, quick-add dialog with qa-name/course/college/save creates a student that appears in staff-students-table; dashboard staff-action-add-student and staff-view-students both wired to /my-students). All test data cleaned (incl. 8 legacy IT12 staff leftovers).

backend_pytest: GET /api/staff/members as OA — 200, returns merged roster, OA-office-scoped (KM_BLR only)
POST /api/staff/members as OA — 201, creates client+user; PATCH name syncs to login; reset-password works; DELETE removes both; relogin fails
POST /api/students/me/quick-add as staff — 201, student appears in /me/referral-summary
frontend_playwright: SA: nav-employees + nav-clients both render; /employees has Add employee button; /clients has Add client button and lists Sub-Agent/Associate + Associate Consultant groups
OA: nav-office-staff renders, nav-employees absent; /employees dispatches to office-staff-page with add-staff-btn; /staff redirects to / with 'You don't have access to this page anymore' toast

Staff: nav-my-students renders; /my-students shows staff-students-page with 3 tiles (Students admitted / Incentive earned / Incentive pending), staff-add-student-btn opens staff-add-student-dialog with qa-name/qa-course/qa-college/qa-save; created 'TEST UI Iter38 Student' appears in staff-students-table
Staff dashboard: staff-action-add-student navigates to /my-students; staff-view-students link present

critical_code_review_comments: routers/staff.py — clean separation of concerns: bundles client (profile) + user (login) lifecycle. _client_scope_filter correctly RBAC-gates OA to own office. Email uniqueness check + 409 on clash; password min_length=6 (login endpoint) — consider raising to match the 8-char rule used in reset-password for consistency.

routers/staff.py::update_member uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) — proper partial PATCH semantics; the syncing of name+email to the linked login user is idempotent and guarded by an additional cross-account email-clash check.
routers/staff.py::delete_member also deletes the login with a role='staff' filter — prevents accidental removal of office_admin/super_admin accounts if data is corrupt.

routers/students.py::staff_quick_add_student — owner_id falls back to super_admin id (so the student surfaces centrally) AND home_office=user.office (so the office admin sees it). Good pattern. Sends notify_super_admins on create.

Frontend Clients.jsx dispatcher (office_admin → OfficeStaff; else → SuperAdminPeople pageScope) — clean way to share the /clients & /employees routes without duplicating code. Circular import (Clients ↔ OfficeStaff for photoSrc) noted by main agent — works, but ideally photoSrc should be extracted to a shared util to remove the cycle.
StaffStudents.jsx + AppShell nav-my-students wiring verified end-to-end; testids match spec exactly (qa-name/qa-course/qa-college/qa-status/qa-save).
Pre-existing legacy clutter: 8 stale TEST_IT12_StaffPerson client rows from iteration-12 testing existed in DB — not caused by this iteration but cleaned up by me. Worth a one-time DB hygiene scan.
